title: Dictionary download stage is spread over Progress.cancelled/finished atomics plus DictManager.download, task and failed Options
trigger: Open Appearance > Spelling > Manage dictionaries, switch a language on, then off while it downloads.
effect: Stage (idle, downloading, cancelling, installing, failed) is implied by 3 atomics and 3 Options kept in step by hand; RowInputs.transfer and RowInputs.failed are two Options for one row state.
fix: One enum Download { Idle, Running{code,progress}, Cancelling{code}, Failed{code,msg} } in DictManager, with the worker result as a typed DownloadOutcome (Done, Cancelled, Failed(msg)).

title: finished is set by the caller after the worker returns, so a panicking worker leaves the manager polling forever
trigger: Download a dictionary whose files make spellbook or ureq panic in the background task (malformed upstream data).
effect: Row stays at Downloading n% and the 120 ms poll loop notifies every tick; start_dictionary_download returns early because download is Some, so no dictionary can be downloaded until restart.
fix: Set finished from a drop guard in the worker, or drive the row from the worker's Result (JoinHandle) rather than a flag; clear download on any task end.

title: Cancel is only seen between body chunks, so a stalled server keeps the row Downloading for up to 180 s after the switch is turned off
trigger: Start a download on a flaky connection that stalls mid-body, flip the switch off.
effect: Switch toggles off in the OS-less sense but the row keeps Downloading n% and toggling again does nothing (toggle_dictionary returns early while download.code matches) until the 180 s global timeout.
fix: Add a Cancelling stage that the row shows at once and drop the download future (cancel the ureq call) instead of polling a flag.

title: A cancel pressed after the last chunk is ignored: install still runs and the language is switched on
trigger: Click the switch off right as the second file finishes.
effect: Dictionary is installed and enabled although the user cancelled; Err("Cancelled.") only returned if the flag was set before the install call.
fix: Make Cancelling a stage that the completion arm checks before set_spell_languages.

title: Cancel is recognised by comparing the error text to "Cancelled."
trigger: Any future change to the string in spell_download turns a cancel into a red failure row.
effect: A user cancel shows as a failed download with an error line.
fix: Return an enum DownloadError::{Cancelled, Message(String)} from download_dictionary.

title: remove_dictionary updates the chosen list even when removing the files failed
trigger: Remove a downloaded dictionary whose file is locked or read-only.
effect: Toast says it could not remove, but the language is dropped from the picked list; if that empties the list the engine silently goes to automatic locale languages.
fix: Return early after the error note; only change the chosen list when remove succeeded.

title: A timed-out ISpellChecker check answers correct, and SpellChecker caches that answer
trigger: Type a misspelled word on Windows while the COM thread is busy loading a cold dictionary (over 5 s) or backlogged with jobs.
effect: The word gets no underline and stays unflagged (cached as correct) until the cache is cleared by learn/unlearn/set_app_words or 20k other words.
fix: Backend returns Option<bool> (Unknown on timeout) and SpellChecker caches only Known answers.

title: is_correct inserts a backend answer after a concurrent clear_cache, so a stale verdict outlives a learn/unlearn
trigger: Background re-check is in is_correct (backend call) while the user picks Add to Dictionary on a macOS-system-learned word; the check then inserts its old false.
effect: Word added to the system dictionary stays underlined until another cache clear.
fix: Tag the cache with a generation counter bumped by clear_cache and drop inserts from an older generation.

title: Cache validity against app_words/ignored/backend learned set is kept by calling clear_cache by hand
trigger: Any new mutator of app_words, ignored or backend state that forgets clear_cache serves stale verdicts.
effect: Stale underline or missing underline.
fix: Put the verdict cache inside the same RwLock-guarded struct as app_words/ignored so a write replaces both.

title: recheck_spelling re-asks the backend on the UI thread for every underlined word after the cache was cleared
trigger: On Windows, or on Linux just after an engine rebuild while the warm thread still parses a big dictionary, choose Add to Dictionary or Ignore.
effect: UI thread blocks on the COM thread (up to 5 s per word, CHECK_WAIT) or on the Hunspell OnceLock until the parse ends.
fix: Run the retain on the background executor or only compare against app_words/ignored on the UI thread (no backend call).

title: Heartbeat.beats Option<u64> is both the started flag (None before start and after stop) and the beat counter
trigger: Launch a second Quill before the link loop starts or after it stops.
effect: Owner acknowledges at once because mark/beats None means not running; correct today but the stage lives in an Option.
fix: enum Heartbeat { NotRunning, Running{beats:u64} }.

title: A launch whose sender thread cannot be spawned reports the live owner as not responding
trigger: Start Quill under thread exhaustion while another Quill runs.
effect: spawn_guarded fails, tx drops, recv_timeout gives Disconnected which maps to Forward::Unresponsive; launch shows Quill isn't responding and refuses to start though the owner is fine.
fix: Map Disconnected to Forward::NoOwner-with-error (Unchecked) instead of Unresponsive.

title: A failed first dictionary load is cached forever in OnceLock<Option<..>>
trigger: Dictionary file is briefly unreadable (antivirus lock, being replaced) when the engine first checks a word.
effect: That language's words are never flagged (is_correct returns true when nothing loaded) until the engine is rebuilt by changing languages or restarting.
fix: Entry stage enum Unloaded / Loaded(dict) / Failed(retry after) instead of a permanent None.

title: Each hunspell_engine build starts a warm thread that keeps parsing after the engine was replaced
trigger: Switch spelling languages several times quickly with large dictionaries.
effect: Several threads parse dictionaries nobody uses (the Arc keeps the backend alive) until done; wasted CPU and memory.
fix: Give warm a cancel token owned by the SpellEngine, set on drop.

title: StarPacksState keeps loading, loaded, error and open as separate fields
trigger: Open Stars, press Buy more Stars (maybe_fetch_star_packs sets loading=true, error=None), request fails or its continuation is dropped
effect: loading/loaded/error can combine (loading+error, loaded+error); a lost answer leaves loading=true with no retry for the session
fix: Replace loading/loaded/error/options with Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> (src/state/fetch.rs); keep open as a UI flag in OnScreen.

title: StarsGiftState holds target, options, loading and error as hand-synchronised fields
trigger: Gift Stars dialog: pick a contact (choose_stars_gift_user), go back (clear_target), pick another
effect: Stages (contact list, loading packs for X, packs for X, failed for X) are encoded by Option target + bool loading + Option error + Vec options
fix: enum GiftStage { Contacts, Packs { target, packs: Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> } } so options belong to a target.

title: Star pack answer for one gift recipient is applied under another recipient (answer not matched to what asked)
trigger: Gift Stars: pick contact A (getStarGiftPaymentOptions in flight), press Back, pick contact B (second request); A's answer lands after B's, or Back is pressed and A's answer lands on the contact list
effect: B's checkout page lists the packs fetched for A (apply.rs:274 sets options and loading=false for any GetStarGiftOptions answer; RequestPurpose::GetStarGiftOptions carries no user id); loading=false is cleared by the first answer while B's is still outstanding. Stars are bought for B with A's pack amounts
fix: Carry the target user id in the purpose (GetStarGiftOptions { user_id }) and apply the answer only when stage is Packs for that user; the enum from the IS entry holds the key.

title: New-login review is review_pending counter + review_confirmed + review_error + review_outcome
trigger: Press Yes it is me or No on the new-login banner with several unconfirmed sessions
effect: Stages (idle, reviewing N, failed, done) are spread over four fields; review_confirmed is written by connect/account_hygiene.rs:53 and never read (dead state); busy is review_pending > 0
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing { confirmed, remaining: Vec<RequestId>, error: Option<String> } } with the outcome taken once by the UI.

title: review_pending sticks above zero when a send fails partway through several sessions
trigger: Banner shows 2+ unconfirmed sessions; user presses Yes; send_json fails on a session that is not the last (client closing)
effect: review_unconfirmed_sessions sets review_pending = ids.len(), then on a send failure calls finish_login_review once (decrement 1) and returns Err, so the ids never sent are never answered; review_pending stays >0, the banner buttons stay busy and review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses (InvalidRequest) until the session ends
fix: Set review_pending only to the number of requests actually sent (increment per send), or use the Reviewing { remaining } enum and drop unsent ids on failure.

title: After a partly failed review, retry re-sends confirmSession/terminateSession for sessions already reviewed
trigger: Two unconfirmed sessions; one confirmSession answers ok and the other errors; user presses Yes again
effect: unconfirmed_entries is kept whole on error (only cleared on a fully clean review), so the retry includes the already confirmed session and errors again; the banner keeps the old error text until the next press
fix: Remove an entry when its own request succeeds; keep per-entry result in the Reviewing stage.

title: Terms accept is terms + terms_in_flight + terms_error
trigger: Accept the terms of service
effect: in-flight bool next to an error and the terms option; the ok answer (session_apply_ok.rs:232) is not matched to the terms id that was sent
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Pending(Terms), Accepting { id }, Failed { terms, error } }.

title: The accept answer clears a newer updateTermsOfService that arrived while accepting
trigger: Accept terms A; before the ok answer, the server pushes updateTermsOfService for terms B
effect: session_apply_ok sets terms=None on any AcceptTermsOfService ok, so B is dropped and the user is never asked for it this session
fix: Accepting { id } and clear terms only when the current terms id equals the one accepted.

title: TwofaFlow is code_sent_to options + notice + refetch flag kept in step with PasswordStateOp answers
trigger: Two-step recovery, reset and login-email flows
effect: recovery_code_sent_to / login_email_code_sent_to / notice are cleared in several places (apply_reset_password_result, apply_password_state_op, apply_password_op_ok, ui clear_twofa_flow, connect/auth.rs); refetch is a take-once flag
fix: enum TwofaFlow { Idle, RecoveryCodeSent{to}, LoginEmailCodeSent{to}, Done(notice) } plus a refetch request token.

title: ActiveCall: state, ready, ready_at and the media flags are separate fields
trigger: Any 1:1 call
effect: ready_at: Option<Instant> and ready: Option<ReadyParams> must change with state == Ready; remote_video/remote_screen/remote_audio_muted, muted, camera_on, screen_sharing are intents and reports kept as bools beside the phase
fix: Fold ready params and ready_at into CallState::Ready { params, since }; keep intents in their own struct.

title: CallSummary upload stages are rating_sent, debug_information_sent/error and log_sent/log_error
trigger: Call ends with need_rating / need_debug_information / need_log
effect: Each upload is a bool sent next to an error option (CI-flagged shape); error handlers reset sent=false by hand, rating has no error arm at all
fix: enum Upload { NotNeeded, Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed(String) } used three times, keyed by the request id.

title: A failed call rating is marked sent and the rating card is dismissed
trigger: Rate a call from the end screen while the sendCallRating request fails (flood wait, offline)
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true after the send; the SendCallRating error arm (domains/calls/error.rs) only sets calls.error and never clears rating_sent, so the card is gone and the rating is lost with only a status line; the UI note said Thanks for your feedback because the send itself returned Ok
fix: Upload enum with Sending then Sent on ok or Failed on error, keyed by the request id; show the card again on Failed.

title: Call log and diagnostics answers are applied to whichever summary is current, not the call that asked
trigger: Finish call A with need_log, start upload, end call B quickly before the answer
effect: SendCallLog ok sets log_sent=true (session_apply_ok.rs:523) and SendCallDebugInformation error sets the error on the new summary of call B; B's own upload prompt disappears or shows A's error. RequestPurpose has no call id
fix: Carry call_id in the purposes and apply only when summary.call_id matches.

title: ActiveGroupCall has both need_rejoin: bool and rejoin: GroupCallRejoin for the same stage
trigger: TDLib reports need_rejoin; Quill rejoins on its own
effect: need_rejoin is copied from updateGroupCall (session_calls.rs:579) while rejoin is the driver's enum; readers use either (live_story.rs:397, session_video_chat_caps.rs:60, session_calls.rs:291 read the bool; join_failed/reconnecting read the enum), so they can disagree
fix: Delete need_rejoin; have updateGroupCall call rejoin.want() and let readers use GroupCallRejoin only.

title: Group call screen sharing is screen_share_pending + screen_sharing + screen_share_paused + screen_share_error + screen_share_answer
trigger: Share screen in a video chat
effect: Stage (off, starting, offer built, live, paused, failed) is four bools/options and a String answer; clears are spread over controls.rs, join.rs:470, offers.rs:322, mod.rs:278-284 and calls/error.rs:201,216; readers always test pending || sharing
fix: enum ScreenShare { Off, Starting { request }, Answered(String), Live { paused }, Failed(String) }.

title: Group call transport is transport_ready + transport_error + join_payload (+ stream_mode/stream)
trigger: Join a video chat
effect: bool ready beside an error and a payload string; join failure is derived from transport_error.is_some() || rejoin == GaveUp
fix: enum GroupTransport { NotJoined, Joining { request }, Handshake(payload), Ready, Failed(String) }.

title: join_as_requested is set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never reset on error
trigger: Open an unjoined video chat while the join-as request fails
effect: maybe_fetch_join_as sets join_as_requested=true first (connect/group_calls/join.rs:223); on a send or server error it stays true, so the Join as picker is never offered for this tracked call
fix: join_as: Fetch<Vec<MessageSender>> reset to Idle on error (or Failed) per group_call_id.

title: Chat list ordering sync is chat_order_sync.dirty + deferred + moved plus the driver's batch.open
trigger: Poll batch of updates
effect: begin_update_batch/end_update_batch and ConnectDriver::begin_batch/end_batch each keep an open flag in step by hand; if a batch is begun and never ended (an early return or panic between them) deferred stays true and the chat list never reorders
fix: One enum OrderSync { Live, InBatch { dirty, moved } } owned by the batch; drop the duplicate batch.open.

title: Files handed to Quill are silently dropped past 256 queued or when duplicated
trigger: Send a folder of 300 files to Quill (Send to menu) while Quill is locked or signed out
effect: push_files keeps the first 256 and discards the rest with no note
fix: Return the dropped count and surface a toast when the UI takes the queue.

title: Files chosen for forwarding are taken from the chooser before the chat is known to have opened
trigger: Pick a chat in the Forward to chooser while select_listed_chat does not open it (chat not in the list, filtered or folder-hidden)
effect: choose_start_files_chat does mem::take on choosing, then select_listed_chat; if open_chat_id() != chat it posts a silent Open the chat to attach note and the files are gone, with the chooser closed
fix: Take the files only after open_chat_id() == Some(chat); otherwise keep the chooser open.

title: A failed busy-decline or swap-prompt decline shows 'Could not hang up the call' on the active call
trigger: In a call, a second caller rings and is declined as busy (or the swap prompt's Decline is used); the caller already cancelled so discardCall errors (e.g. 400)
effect: The error banner 'Could not hang up the call' appears on the ongoing call's overlay although nothing about that call failed. All three discardCall senders use the same RequestPurpose::DiscardCall and the arm sets calls.error whenever hang_up does not match
fix: Give the decline discard its own purpose (DeclineCall{call_id}) and set calls.error only for the request that owns HangUp

title: A failed game button press (GetCallbackQueryAnswerGame) gives no feedback
trigger: Press a game button in a bot chat while the bot does not answer (TDLib 502) or offline
effect: Nothing happens: apply_bots_error notes an answer for GetCallbackQueryAnswer and ...WithPassword only, the Game purpose falls to the default arm
fix: Handle the Game purpose in the same arm as the plain callback

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus an error and pending phone/timeout options
trigger: Settings > change number: send code, resend, check
effect: Stage is spread over change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_error, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout; the checks in connect/auth.rs use different guards for each and a lost answer relies on error arm clearing
fix: enum ChangeNumber{Idle,Sending,CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending},Checking{phone},Failed{..}} with the request id inside Sending/Checking

title: 2FA management uses password_state_loading beside password_op_error and password_state
trigger: Open Two-step verification, run get/set/recovery ops
effect: A bool in flight flag shared by every PasswordStateOp request, an error string and the cached state are kept in step by hand
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an op enum holding the request ids in flight

title: One 2FA op's answer or error clears the shared in-flight flag while another op is still in flight
trigger: Start getPasswordState then quickly a setPassword/resend; first one answers
effect: password_state_loading becomes false while the second request is pending; the overlay re-enables submits and a late error overwrites password_op_error
fix: Track in-flight request ids (Vec<RequestId>) and clear loading only when empty; or one Fetch per op

title: my_rights_fetched bool beside my_restriction option
trigger: Open a group chat; own member record arrives
effect: Three states (unknown, not restricted, restricted) are encoded as a bool plus an Option and kept in step by set_my_restriction
fix: enum OwnRestriction{Unknown,None,Restricted(MemberRestriction)}

title: Own admin rights are seven Options set by separate setters next to my_member_status
trigger: Own status changes from administrator to member/creator in a channel
effect: set_member_status resets only my_admin_can_post_messages; the other six my_admin_can_* stay until their own setters run and are only hidden by the match on my_member_status
fix: ChannelMemberStatus::Administrator{rights: AdminRights} so rights exist only for an administrator

title: ConferenceCall::link_open bool and upgrade option track the Add People/share-link stage
trigger: Upgrade a 1:1 call to a conference and pick Share link
effect: link_open, upgrade.share_link and migrated_from are kept consistent by hand
fix: enum ConferenceStage{Upgrading(ConferenceUpgrade),SharingLink,Running}

title: begin_conference overwrites a join in flight, the first answer is then treated as a rejoin
trigger: Double activate Accept on a conference invitation or link before the first groupCallInfo answers
effect: The first answer no longer matches pending_conference (take_if by request id) so accept_conference_joined skips tracking but still queues a fetch and stores a join payload for an untracked call; the second joins normally
fix: Refuse begin_conference while pending_conference is Some (or cancel the old request id explicitly)

title: A ringing conference invitation has no local expiry or way out except TDLib content updates
trigger: Receive an invitation, lose connection or miss the updateMessageContent for was_missed
effect: calls.conference_invite stays Some: ringtone keeps looping, further calls and invitations are declined as busy
fix: Store the ring start and drop the invite on tick after CONFERENCE_INVITE_RING_SECS (manual clock in tests)

title: ConferenceInviteResults keeps pending requests that can never settle if the call goes first
trigger: Add people to a new conference, then leave the conference before all invite answers arrive
effect: is_done never becomes true for a dropped request so invite_results lingers and its toast never shows
fix: Clear invite_results with the conference call, or settle pending as failed when the request is taken

title: Inline query pages are matched by (chat, bot) only, an older response lands on a newer query
trigger: Type an inline query, change the text quickly; the older answer returns last
effect: The picker shows results of the previous query text (acknowledged in the ponytail comment; the UI debounces)
fix: Put a query generation in BotsPurpose::GetInlineQueryResults and compare it with the slot

title: last_callback_answer and last_login_url_info are single slots drained on poll, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Press two inline buttons (or two login buttons) before the poll drains the first answer
effect: The first button's toast, alert or URL is lost; login answer is not matched to the press that asked (login_url_request is also one slot)
fix: Queue answers keyed by request id, or key each by (chat, message, button)

title: game_scores encodes closed/loading/loaded as map presence and Option
trigger: Open and close a game's high-score panel
effect: absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some) = loaded; callers insert and remove entries by hand (ui/message_games.rs) and the answer fills only an existing entry
fix: HashMap<(chat,msg), Fetch<Vec<GameHighScore>>> with an explicit Closed removal

title: Create Bot dialog stage is check_pending, creating, created, error and check options
trigger: Create Bot dialog: type username, create
effect: Stage spread over check_pending/creating/created/error/check; BotEditTexts likewise holds load_failed bool beside name/about options and loads vec
fix: enum CreateBot{Editing{check:Fetch<..>},Creating{gen},Created(user),Failed(msg)} and Fetch<(name,about)> for the edit texts

title: 1:1 call stage kept in answered_call, hang_up, second_call and active_call.state together
trigger: Answer, hang up, swap calls
effect: answered_call (Option<i32>) is a 'Pending but answered' flag beside ActiveCall.state; hang_up owns HangingUp beside it; second_call is an enum but depends on hang_up
fix: Put Answered inside CallState / ActiveCall phase so a single enum value holds it

title: Call privacy and recent-calls use a counter, error bools and a clearing bool
trigger: Open Calls settings and the Recent calls tab, Clear all
effect: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error bool; recent_calls_request + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_clearing bool are separate fields with their own clearers
fix: Fetch<..> for privacy and recent calls and a ClearCalls{request} stage

title: Screen share stage is screen_share_pending and screen_sharing bools cleared together
trigger: Start or stop screen sharing in a group call
effect: Two bools plus screen_share_answer are reset by hand in two error arms and elsewhere
fix: enum ScreenShare{Off,Starting,On{answer},Stopping}

title: failed_creates grows when no UI drains it (background account)
trigger: createVideoChat is refused on an account that is not on screen
effect: The request id stays in CallsState::failed_creates until the UI shows it; a switch back shows an old failure
fix: Drop on a timer or hold the failure in the create_join_as/start stage value

title: folder_link_saved is a one-shot bool not tied to the folder or dialog that asked
trigger: Open the share dialog of folder A, create a link, close it, open folder B's share dialog before A's answer; or the answer lands after the dialog was reopened
effect: The answer sets folder_link_saved for any pending folder_id and the next drain flips whichever dialog is open back to the list view and clears busy
fix: Return the saved result as an event carrying the folder id, and apply it only when the open dialog is for that folder

title: Cache eviction of reply-bar fetches drops entries by smallest key, not by age, and a Loaded copy is never refreshed
trigger: Reply to an old message that was fetched with getMessage, then the original is edited (or others evict it)
effect: The bar keeps the stale text of a fetched copy (edits arrive only for rows in a history); eviction can remove another window's target and refetch
fix: Keep fetch order (insertion index) for eviction, and apply updateMessageContent to Loaded copies

title: Previews are matched by URL only and evicted while Asked; more than KEPT composers re-ask
trigger: More than eight composers/windows with distinct links typed at once
effect: An Asked entry is evicted before its answer, the answer is dropped and the chip asks again
fix: Never evict Asked entries, or key the answer by request id

title: Archive settings panel: loading bool + open bool + Option settings kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Settings > Archive; fetch is sent and loading is set only when no cached copy exists; answer or error clears it
effect: Two bools plus an Option stand in for one fetch stage; a dropped answer leaves loading true
fix: Use Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> for the settings and keep the panel-open flag as a UI (OnScreen) field, not in Session.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog: link, info, error, done and request id are five fields moved together
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields by hand, sets the request id after the send; close_folder_invite resets four again but not folder_invite_request
effect: Stage (checking / checked / adding / done / failed) is implied by which of five fields is set; close leaves the request id set so a late answer still fills info after the dialog closed
fix: One enum FolderInvite { Idle, Checking{link,req}, Checked{link,info}, Adding{..}, Done, Failed{link,reason} } replaced whole on open/close.

title: Folder share one-shot flags and errors: folder_link_saved bool, folder_share_error, folder_limit_hit drained by UI
trigger: A link create/edit or a failure sets a one-shot the UI drains on a poll
effect: Outcome is a bool/Option latch that any dialog can drain, not matched to a folder or request
fix: Push typed outcomes (with folder id) onto a queue like CommunitiesState::outcomes.

title: Folder share error is not matched to the folder or request that failed
trigger: Share Folder dialog open for folder A while a link request for folder B (or a recommended-folders fetch) fails
effect: The error text shows in A's dialog; the dialog for the failed request sees nothing
fix: Carry the folder id (or request id) in the error and show it only to the dialog for that folder.

title: Failed preview fetch overwrites the single preview slot of a different chat
trigger: Hover/peek chat A (getChatHistory out), then peek chat B; B answers, then A's request fails (or A answers late)
effect: The slot now holds A's failure/messages; B's preview finds no data for its chat and shows a spinner or error although it loaded
fix: Key previews by ChatId (HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<..>>) or drop an answer whose chat is not the one currently previewed; fetch_chat_preview_history only dedupes per chat but clears the shared slot.

title: getChatFolder failure gives no feedback when it was asked for the edit dialog or an edit chain
trigger: Edit a folder whose cached spec is stale; getChatFolder fails (offline/flood)
effect: Only the remove-from-folder queue case sets an error; the edit dialog waits on fresh_spec that never arrives (no failed stage), until reopened
fix: Fetch<ChatFolderSpec> per folder id, so Failed is a stage the dialog can show and retry.

title: chat_action_error is one slot overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two chat-list actions (pin, mark unread) fail before the UI drains the note
effect: Only the last error is shown; the first is lost
fix: Queue of notes instead of Option<String>.

title: Page retry: exhausted bool + retry Option per list (main, archive) with a separate folder set
trigger: LoadChats 404 sets chats_exhausted and clears retry; other errors set retry with doubling wait
effect: Paging stage (idle/loading/backoff/exhausted) is spread over chats_exhausted, chats_retry and PendingRequest presence
fix: enum PageStage { More, Backoff{until,wait}, Exhausted } per list; in-flight stays in the request table.

title: Deep-link flow split over deep_link, deep_link_original, deep_link_seq and deep_link_from_agent
trigger: A link opens: start sets four fields; terminal states are reached through six paths (Notice, limit box, web fallback, error, Ui, text); each path must reset original and the agent flag by hand
effect: deep_link=None is set on the wallet-notice and limit-box paths without clearing deep_link_from_agent or deep_link_original; correct only because every start re-sets them
fix: Fold original and from_agent into the DeepLinkState variants (or a DeepLinkFlow struct with a generation) so ending the flow drops all of it.

title: Deep-link stale check ignores states past ResolvingInfo/ResolvingChat
trigger: DeepLinkJoin or CheckInvite fails after the flow already moved to Info/InvitePreview (e.g. the user confirmed a second action)
effect: stale is true so the failure is ignored and the flow stays in its current state without any error while the join request is lost
fix: Match the generation on every DeepLinkState variant that carries one, not only the two resolving ones.

title: setDefaultBackground answer is filed under the current background_set_for_dark, not the theme the request was for
trigger: Set a wallpaper while light, switch the app to dark before the answer lands
effect: default_backgrounds[dark] gets the light wallpaper
fix: Put for_dark in the pending purpose (SetDefaultBackground { for_dark }) and drop the shared field.

title: chat_look_oks u32 counter: the chat colors dialog counts oks to know the save finished
trigger: Save in the chat colors dialog sends 1 to 3 requests; each ok bumps the counter, the dialog compares to the number it sent
effect: Counter is not matched to the dialog or the requests it sent, and an error leaves it short of the target
fix: Track the dialog's own request ids (set of RequestId) and finish when all are answered.

title: Chat photo, theme and background caches are keyed by bare chat id and never pruned (chat_upgrades Vec grows)
trigger: Upgrade many basic groups over a long session
effect: chat_upgrades only grows; stale entries are re-scanned
fix: Drain the pairs once the UI consumed them, or store as map old->new.

title: getLoginUrl answer stored in one slot without matching the request
trigger: Tap two login-url buttons quickly; the first answer arrives after the second request was sent
effect: The open-URL consent for the first button is shown with the second answer, or the second answer is replaced
fix: Key the answer by RequestId or message so each button consumes its own.

title: getBackgroundUrl answer lands in a global slot
trigger: Open the wallpaper preview Share for wallpaper A, close, open B before the answer for A
effect: background_url holds A's link while B's preview is open
fix: Return a Fetch keyed by the preview's request id.

title: A late add-chat-requests page is applied by purpose, not matched to the list generation
trigger: Open the requests list (page 1), scroll to load page 2, refresh (page 1 again) while page 2 is in flight
effect: Page 2's answer appends to the new list and overwrites next_offset with an older offset, so paging repeats or skips
fix: Keep the asking RequestId (or a list generation) in AddChatRequestList and drop other pages, as invite_pages does.

title: Processing one add-chat request while a page is in flight brings the handled request back
trigger: Approve a request while getCommunityAddChatRequests is in flight
effect: The page answer re-inserts the request that was just handled; it stays visible until the next reload
fix: Drop in-flight page requests in drop_add_chat_request as reset_add_chat_requests does, or remember handled chat ids.

title: Community request tracking mixes in-flight table, notification_sends map and outcomes queue
trigger: setCommunityNotificationSettings: settings are parked in notification_sends under the request id; on ok moved into the full info; on error removed
effect: An entry is removed only on ok or error; a request settled another way (take_purpose, dropped continuation) leaves the entry and community_notification_settings keeps showing the unsent value
fix: Store the sent settings inside PendingRequest (or the purpose) so removing the request removes them.

title: Outcomes queue is only drained by the screen; a background account's outcomes pile up and are reported late
trigger: Add a chat to a community in account A, switch to B before the answer; return to A
effect: forget_outcomes clears them on return, so the success/fail toast is lost
fix: Report the outcome as a note on the account on screen at the time, or keep it keyed and drop only stale ones.

title: Boost list page: loading bool + error + request id in BoostsListState
trigger: Open Boosts tab; page request sets loading and request; the reply clears loading, error and request together
effect: Three fields stand for one Fetch stage; the error arm in error.rs must clear them by hand
fix: Fetch<Page> with the request id in the Loading variant.

title: Invite member and join-request pages: loading bool + error + request id
trigger: Open an invite link's details; each page sets and clears the trio
effect: Same trio as boosts; clears only when the answering id matches
fix: Fetch<Page> with request id.

title: Chat-wide join-request pages: a late older answer applies once join_request_latest was removed
trigger: Search join requests (R1 'a'), then 'ab' (R2); R2 answers (latest removed), then R1 answers
effect: is_none_or accepts R1, replacing the list with the older query's results
fix: Keep the latest id until a new query replaces it, or reject ids lower than the last applied one.

title: Admin list answer applied after a membership update dropped the cache
trigger: Open the admin list; getChatAdministrators in flight; updateChatMember arrives (removes admin_lists entry); answer lands
effect: The pre-change list is stored as Loaded and shown until the next membership change
fix: Drop in-flight admin list requests in UpdateChatMember, or tag the fetch with a revision.

title: New join request bumps total_count while a search filter hides it
trigger: Search join requests for 'x' (join_request_queries non-empty); a request from someone else arrives
effect: The request is not inserted but total_count is incremented, so the list count exceeds the shown rows
fix: Bump the total only when the request is inserted or matches the query.

title: Boost chain: boost_intent Option<i64> + boost_slots_by_chat + boost_box phase kept in step
trigger: Press Boost: intent set, slots fetched, boostChat sent; answers clear intent in two places (boost_flow.rs, error.rs)
effect: Stage lives in an Option as a started flag plus a per-chat stash, boost box phase, and note
fix: enum BoostFlow { Idle, FetchingSlots{chat}, Boosting{chat,slots}, Done } owned by the box.
